description: Baseline + Problem 1: make level-up progression, card draws, the pause gate, the card RNG, and the wire card-action byte PER-PLAYER, so each co-op player picks their own upgrades onto their own (already-per-player) weapon/passive stores, fully deterministic and replay-revalidatable. First establish the test baseline, then do the sim/run refactor, then the wire-format change (bump PROTOCOL_VERSION), then route the app card UI through the net session. See .agents/tasks/task-coop-per-player/design.md Problem 1.
steps: BASELINE FIRST: from repo root run `bun run test:game`. Confirm the ONLY failing suite is packages/mobile/game/config/remote-config.test.ts (12 checks, caused by COOP flag defaulting ON - pre-existing, do NOT fix, do NOT touch the COOP flag). Record which suites pass so regressions are detectable. Do not modify remote-config.

run.ts: replace the single `this.prog` Progression with a per-player array prog[0..MAX_PLAYERS-1] (new Progression() each). Keep a `get prog()` accessor returning prog[0] so existing solo call sites (HUD readout, finish/summary, dev menu, run.test.ts, inrun.test.ts) keep working identically. Add a per-player accessor (e.g. progFor(p)).

run.ts applyCollections(): credit banked XP and gold to the player who collected it (pickups.collectPlayer / the per-player xp bank) rather than always players.x[0]/this.prog. Investigate pickups.ts to see how xp/gold banking is attributed; if xp is banked globally today, thread per-player attribution through so each player's own progression levels on their own gems. Keep gold semantics documented.

run.ts: replace the single `this.cards` CardDraw with cards[0..MAX_PLAYERS-1]. Add `get cards()` accessor returning cards[0] and a per-player accessor cardsFor(p). CardDraw methods already take a player arg - call resetRun/beginScreen/pick/reroll/skip/banish/relabel with the matching slot index.

run.ts: replace the single `run.paused` gate. Add per-player paused (that player's cards[p].open || their arcana screen) AND a global `paused` getter that is true when ANY player has a screen open (documented rule: the shared world freezes while any player is choosing, preserving the 'a decision while the crowd closes in is not a decision' invariant and keeping all sims frozen on identical ticks). Run.tick() must advance zero sim steps while any screen is open and, per player with an open screen, resolve autoPick from that player's first offer so headless parties never deadlock.

run.ts tick(): the level-up + card-open + growth-step section currently runs once for player 0. Run it per player: each player's own progression.owesCards opens that player's cards[p].beginScreen(p,...) with that player's card RNG; each player's growth-step rebuild keys off that player's level. Emit level-up/card cues per player (cue value already carries a player field in several emits).

run.ts card RNG: preserve the single-seeded-stream discipline. Give each player a deterministic seed-derived card RNG. Player 0's stream MUST stay bit-identical to today's this.cardRng so existing solo replays/hashes do not shift. Implement by either adding RNG_STREAMS entries cardDraw (existing, for p0) + cardDraw1..3 seeded from the same run seed via the existing reseedStreams(seed) hashName scheme, or by deriving per-slot Rng from RNG_STREAMS.cardDraw with a fixed per-slot salt. Document the choice in cards.ts header alongside the existing stream-discipline prose.

run.ts: make pickCard/rerollCards/skipCard/banishCard accept a `player` arg (default 0 to preserve solo call sites) and operate on cards[player]/prog[player]. restoreGrowthAfterPick and rebuildLoadout become per-player (each slot's growth ladder/tier - coordinate with FEAT-002 which supplies per-slot character records; for FEAT-001 alone, keep a per-player growthTier keyed off that player's level).

run.ts hashState(): it already hashes per-player x/y/health/upright. Per-player progression level/xp and card-open state are derived state that affects stats/weapons which already hash - but add explicit mixing of each player's progression level and each open card draw's choice-relevant state if needed for early divergence detection (keep it deterministic and device-independent; document). Verify player-0-only solo hash is unchanged (run.test.ts / replay.test.ts).
run.ts rehydrate(): relabel each OPEN per-player card draw for its own slot (was cards.relabel(...,0)).

protocol.ts: change RECORD_STRIDE to MAX_PLAYERS*4 + MAX_PLAYERS (per-player card byte). Update any confirm-window budget math. BUMP PROTOCOL_VERSION from 4 to 5 (wire-format change - documented rule).

messages.ts: update tickRecordBytes(playerCount)=playerCount*4+playerCount, encodeTickConfirm/decodeTickRecord to carry playerCount card-action bytes (one per player) after the input bytes. Update the doc comment. Confirm tickConfirmBytes stays within MAX_MESSAGE_BYTES at 4 players + CONFIRM_WINDOW_TICKS; if not, reduce the window and document.

session.ts: ConfirmRing stride follows RECORD_STRIDE; cardActionOf(tick, player) reads that player's byte. HostSession: add a per-slot pendingCard for the host's own slot (guests already have GuestConn.pendingCard). HostSession.step(): write EACH player's pending card action into THAT player's card byte (host into its localSlot byte, each guest into its slot byte), gated on whether that player's screen is open per the confirmed world - NOT 'whoever asked first'. Clear each pending after sealing.

session.ts applyRecord(): loop players; for each non-NONE card byte call a per-player applyCardAction(run, player, action) that routes to run.pickCard(index, player)/rerollCards(player)/skipCard(player)/banishCard(index, player). applyCardAction gains a player arg (default 0).

app/dev/play.tsx: in the pick/reroll/skip callbacks (and add banish if the UI has it), when a co-op run is live (netRunRef.current !== null) call netRunRef.current.requestCardAction(mappedAction) instead of run.pickCard(...) directly - this is the fix for the guest 'pick reverts after 1-2s' bug. Solo path keeps calling run.pickCard directly. Map UI index/reroll/skip/banish to CARD_ACTION.PICK_n/REROLL/SKIP/BANISH_n.

app/dev/play.tsx: readCards(run) reads the LOCAL player's draw (run.cardsFor(localSlot)); the card overlay shows/hides on the local player's cards.open, not the global. localSlot = coopRef.current?.connection.localSlot ?? 0.

save/snapshot.ts: snapshot and restore per-player progression + per-player card-draw state (offers, picksRemaining, charges, banish lists). Verify save/snapshot.test.ts and save/resume.test.ts stay green; extend them if the format widened.

Tests: extend net/wire.test.ts for the per-player card byte round-trip. Extend net/session.test.ts (section 4 or a new section) so TWO players each answer their OWN card screen on the same session and assert: both worlds stay hash-identical (firstDivergentTick), each player's own weapons/passives changed and the other's did not. Extend sim/cards.test.ts and run/run.test.ts for per-player draws/progression, INCLUDING a determinism guard that player-0/solo output is unchanged from before.
Run `bun run test:game` and the changed suites directly; confirm no regression vs baseline and remote-config is unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: PROTOCOL_VERSION is bumped in net/protocol.ts and RECORD_STRIDE carries one card-action byte per player.

In a 2+ player headless session (net/session.test.ts harness), each player answers their OWN card screen and both/all simulations remain hash-identical to the end (firstDivergentTick reports no divergence).
Each player's pick is applied to that player's own weapon/passive store only, not to a single shared player-0 loadout.
Solo / player-0 behaviour is byte-identical to before the change (a determinism-guard assertion in run.test.ts or cards.test.ts passes).
app/dev/play.tsx routes co-op card actions through netRun.requestCardAction and reads the local player's card draw for its UI.
`bun run test:game` shows no regression vs the recorded baseline; the only failing suite remains config/remote-config.test.ts with the same 12 checks.
verification: bun run test:game (from repo root) - compare to baseline; remote-config unchanged, nothing else fails
findings:
Implemented per-player progression/cards/pause/card-RNG/wire-byte. KEY DECISIONS & FACTS for FEAT-002/003:
- Per-player progression and card draws are held on Run as plain objects `progAll`/`cardsAll` keyed 0..3 (NOT arrays), on purpose: the reflective snapshot walker (save/snapshot.ts) DESCENDS into plain objects but SKIPS arrays-of-objects, so this shape keeps per-player state in the resume snapshot for free. `get prog()`/`get cards()` return slot 0; `progFor(p)`/`cardsFor(p)` added. Do not turn these into arrays.
- Stats are SHARED across the party (one stat table). WeaponStore/PassiveStore are per-player STORES, but passives from every seat fold into the one shared ModifierStack/Stats via rebuildLoadout. So 'each player's own weapons/passives changed' means the per-player STORE slots (weapons.levelOf(p,..), passives.levelOf(p,..)), which is what the session test asserts. Growth ladder is still SHARED and keyed off player 0's level (growthTierAt) — left that way deliberately for FEAT-001 to keep solo byte-identical; FEAT-002 supplies per-slot character records and should make growth per-slot (rebuildLoadout/growthTierAt).
- Card RNG: player 0 uses RNG_STREAMS.cardDraw UNCHANGED (bit-identical solo); slots 1..3 use new streams cardDraw1/2/3 added to core/rng.ts, reseeded via the same (seed ^ hashName(name)) scheme. run.cardRngs[p] is the per-slot Rng.
- XP/gold now credited per collector: added pickups.xpBankedBy[]/goldBankedBy[] (Float32Array[MAX_PLAYERS]), exact even on event-buffer overflow. run.applyCollections loops players. Chest coins credited to opener. Solo byte-identical because in solo everything is collected by player 0.
- hashState mixes each live seat's prog.level/xp/gold/pending in slot order. Card-open state is DELIBERATELY NOT hashed (would move the solo hash and invalidate existing replays). Solo hash unchanged — replay.test.ts passes.
- Wire: PROTOCOL_VERSION 4->5. RECORD_STRIDE = MAX_PLAYERS*4 + MAX_PLAYERS (one card byte per player). tickRecordBytes = playerCount*4+playerCount. CONFIRM_REDUNDANCY_TICKS trimmed 64->56 so a 4-player confirm at full redundancy (1130 bytes) still fits MAX_MESSAGE_BYTES(1200); CONFIRM_WINDOW_TICKS(24) unchanged. cardActionOf(tick,playerCount,player=0). applyCardAction(run,action,player=0). applyRecord loops players. HostSession.step seals EACH player's pending into its own byte gated on run.pausedFor(p) (host uses this.pendingCard for its localSlot; guests use GuestConn.pendingCard).
- Run co-op pause rule: run.paused = ANY seat's card screen open OR arcanas.open (whole world freezes while anyone chooses); run.pausedFor(p) added. tick() resolves autoPick for EVERY open seat so headless parties never deadlock.
- App: app/dev/play.tsx pick/reroll/skip now route through netRunRef.current.requestCardAction(CARD_ACTION.*) in co-op (fixes the guest 'pick reverts' bug); solo still calls run.pickCard directly. readCards(run, player) reads the LOCAL slot (coopRef.current?.connection.localSlot ?? 0); the overlay open/close uses run.cardsFor(localSlot).open.
TESTS: net/wire.test.ts +per-player card byte round-trip (four-player record now 20 bytes, PROTOCOL_VERSION 5). net/session.test.ts section 4 rewritten: two players each answer their own screen, worlds stay hash-identical, each seat's own store changes, per-player card bytes identical on both machines. sim/cards.test.ts +two-seat independent-store draw test. run/run.test.ts +determinism guard (solo reproducible; run.prog===progFor(0), run.cards===cardsFor(0)).
VERIFICATION: full `bun run test:game` matches baseline EXACTLY — only config/remote-config.test.ts fails (same 12 checks, pre-existing COOP-flag issue, untouched). All suites before AND after remote-config in the chain pass when run directly. cd packages/mobile && bunx tsc --noEmit clean. `bun run lint` has 2 PRE-EXISTING errors in files I did not touch (__env.d.ts template file; unused TICK_SECONDS in the untracked net-run.ts); linting only my 11 changed files is clean.
NOTES: Preserved the pre-existing uncommitted co-op-relocation/lobby/handoff edits (package.json, app/coop/index.tsx, app/index.tsx, app/stages.tsx, lobby/lobby.ts, lobby/session.ts) and untracked coop-handoff/net-run files — did NOT stage or commit them; they are FEAT-002/003 territory. Removed KIRO-CHAT-BUG.md at the user's explicit request (they did not want the client-bug report).
